fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. Shem, Ham and Japheth are the three, and from them the whole earth was populated (Genesis 9:19). Three brothers, and the whole earth full of people! I once stamped one batch of cookies and needed a nap. These three had a whole planet to fill.

A vineyard, baker! Noah, a man of the soil, plants one, and then he drinks some of its wine (Genesis 9:20-21). Now, I know a thing or two about batches that go sideways. I once left a tray in the oven for one more minute. ONE minute. The text doesn't hide what happened next, and neither will I. We'll see it in the next card.

Olive grove! I get it, friend. It sounds so farmer-ish, so very Bible. And I bet it would've been a lovely grove. But the verse says Noah, a man of the soil, planted a vineyard (Genesis 9:20). Verse 21 then mentions its wine. No olives anywhere in this one. Don't worry, I've picked the wrong topping before too, and the cookies forgave me.
